Finds out which body of a physics world contains a point of the world. If several do, the one that was made first is returned. With sensors included this is how a region that does something once something is in it (a trigger volume) is asked.

The body is kept for `GetPhysicsHitEntity`; the point is `GetPhysicsHitX`, `GetPhysicsHitY` and `GetPhysicsHitZ`, and the normal and the distance are 0.
@param x The point, x.
@param y The point, y.
@param z The point, z.
@param mask_low The layers to look at, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask (bit n is layer n). -1 (default) looks at all layers.
@param mask_high The layers 32 to 63, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask. -1 (default) looks at all layers.
@param sensors 1 also finds sensors (see `PhysicsSensor`); 0 (default) leaves them out.
@param world The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world.
@returns The entity of a body that contains the point, or 0 if there is none.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
